subject.title: [Bug]: Regression of #65533 — reasoning/reasoning_details completely dropped from message history for MiniMax M3 via OpenRouter (both plain-text and tool-call turns)

question: Should maintainers accept the linked PR's route-accurate loopback proof for MiniMax M3 reasoning replay, or require a live OpenRouter/MiniMax M3 next-request payload capture before merge?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the remaining choice is maintainer acceptance of proof scope for an external provider route that this read-only review did not live-test.

options.title: Accept Route-Accurate Proof
options.body: Review the linked PR as the canonical fix and accept its production transport loopback proof if the code path matches the unavailable live route.

options.title: Require Live Provider Proof
options.body: Keep the issue and linked PR open until a redacted OpenRouter/MiniMax M3 next-request payload capture confirms the real route.

recommendation.title: Accept Route-Accurate Proof
recommendation.body: Review the linked PR as the canonical fix and accept its production transport loopback proof if the code path matches the unavailable live route.
